items.title: Neurosymbolic planning using natural language communication for cooperative autonomous vehicles
items.summary: Imagine you are driving toward an intersection. A truck parked on the corner blocks your view of a car speeding toward the intersection from the right. You can’t see it, but the car next to you can. What if that neighboring vehicle could simply tell your car, “Vehicle merging from the right, about 15 meters away, moving quickly.” Your car now knows something its own sensors could never observe. This simple idea of cars helping each other by describing what they see in natural language motivates UNCAP , our new framework for cooperative autonomous driving. But there’s an important twist: not every neighboring vehicle is worth listening to, and not every message deserves the same level of trust.
